text: The lane by our apartment has a tiny rough patch; vehicles pass normally.
The bus jolts hard over missing asphalt outside Pink City market every morning.
A motorcyclist crashed into a deep hole beside the school entrance; send help now.
Ek lamp ka glass thoda dusty hai but roshni theek aa rahi hai.
Raat ko colony ke chaar pole nahi jalte; log phone torch se chal rahe hain.
School gate ke saamne bilkul andhera hai aur fast gaadiyan bachchon ko narrowly miss kar rahi hain.
नाली के ढक्कन पर सूखे पत्ते हैं, पानी अभी निकल जाता है।
बारिश के बाद नाला भरकर फुटपाथ पर बहता है, कई दिनों से सफाई नहीं हुई।
अस्पताल के बाहर सीवेज का पानी मरीजों के रास्ते में बह रहा है, संक्रमण का डर है।
The public tap has a slow drip that leaves only a damp mark.
A pipe joint behind the shops sprays water steadily, reducing pressure in nearby homes.
Water is pouring from a burst main beside an electrical cabinet; the street is flooded.
Plastic cups are scattered near the park bench; the bin still has room.
Kachra gaadi kai din nahi aayi, gali ke kone mein bags sad rahe hain.
बच्चों के खेल मैदान के पास सड़ा कचरा और टूटी शीशियाँ फैली हैं, तुरंत हटाएँ।
